# WAF Tuning Log

## WAF-03 Changes (2026-03-09)
Applied to all 5 workspaces (prod, qa, staging, sha, bi). All rules remain in **preview mode**.

### Changes Made
1. **Eliminated rule 1080** (methodenforcement) — blocked PUT/PATCH/DELETE, incompatible with 46+ REST APIs
2. **Added rule 1035** (allow) — excludes mobile app task finish/inspection from XSS check (base64 evidence via okhttp on api.liftit.co)
3. **Added rule 1045** (allow) — excludes Keycloak OAuth callback and login-actions from LFI/SQLi false positives (.profile in Google scope, -- in tab_id)
4. **Modified rule 1100** — opt_out_rule_ids for id921150-protocolattack (multipart boundary \r in ARG_NAMES, affects 11+ apps doing file uploads)

### Apps Inventory (behind WAF)
- **41 GKE microservices** (Helm deploys) — all in prod-apps-454414
- **13 GCS frontends** (static sites) — prod-apps-454414
- **11 VM apps with LB**: urlshortener, sonar, osrm, monitor (shared-016), metabase, superset, wrenai-poc, streamlit (liftit-bi), airflow, workflows, inventarios (prod-apps-454414)
- Helisa (no LB, RDP only — not affected)

### Key False Positive Patterns Found
- Rule 1100/id921150: `\r` in multipart uploads (backoffice-api, lms-excel-loader, attachment-domain, services-domain, etc)
- Rule 1080/id911100: PUT/PATCH/DELETE methods (all REST APIs)
- Rule 1050/id930120: `.profile` in Keycloak Google OAuth scope
- Rule 1040/id941130: `g;base64` in mobile app photo evidence
- Rule 1030/id942100: `--` in Keycloak tab_id, guiones in order data

### Real Attacks Detected
- Rule 1060: RCE scanner `$((41*271))` on api.liftit.co
- Rule 1030: SQLi `\r\nSELECT/UPDATE` on support-admin.liftit.co (Django admin, auth-required)
- Rule 1040: XSS `<?xml` bot scanning keycloak.liftit.co/xmlrpc.php

## TODO: Re-analysis on 2026-03-23
- [ ] Run deep WAF log analysis again after 2 weeks of monitoring with new rules
- [ ] Check if WAF-03 exclusions eliminated false positives
- [ ] Look for NEW false positive patterns not seen before
- [ ] Evaluate if rules can be moved from preview to active (enforce mode)
- [ ] Focus on: rules 1030, 1040, 1050, 1060 residual false positives
- [ ] Check rule 1170 (rate limiting) hits after 2 weeks

# sec/waf — Web Application Firewall (Cloud Armor)

## What This Module Does
Configures Google Cloud Armor WAF policies using direct `google_compute_security_policy` resources. One policy per workspace run — the workspace determines which GCP project the policy deploys to via `local.project_id[terraform.workspace]`. No provider aliases.

## Architecture
Single code path, workspace resolves the target project. Deploy per workspace: qa, staging, prod, sha, bi (sec workspace also supported).

- **Rule source**: `local.waf_rules` in `locals.tf` — single source of truth for all 17 rules (1010-1170)
- **IP whitelist**: `local.ip_whitelist` in `locals.tf` — workspaces without an entry skip rule 1000

## State

- **Workspaces**: qa, staging, prod, sha, bi (+ sec)

locals {
  # Creamos los backends a partir de las apps
  apps_backends = [
    for name, app in local.apps[terraform.workspace] : {
      name              = "${app.name}-backend"
      type              = "instance_group"
      region            = "us-east1"
      zone              = app.zone
      host_patterns     = app.host_patterns
      paths             = app.paths
      instance_group_id = module.apps-vm[name].instance_group_self_link
      health_check      = app.health_check
    }
  ]

  # Backend adicional para servicedesk.liftit.co → mismo instance group de inventarios, puerto 8080
  servicedesk_backends = terraform.workspace == "prod" ? [
    {
      name              = "servicedesk-backend"
      type              = "instance_group"
      region            = "us-east1"
      zone              = "us-east1-c"
      host_patterns     = ["servicedesk.liftit.co"]
      paths             = ["/"]
      instance_group_id = module.apps-vm["inventarios"].instance_group_self_link
      port_name         = "servicedesk"
      health_check = {
        port         = 8080
        request_path = "/status.php"
      }
    }
  ] : []
}

module "load-balancer" {
  source                           = "git::ssh://git@github.com/liftitapp/tf-modules.git//load-balancer"
  load_balancer_type               = "application"
  scope                            = "global"
  load_balancer_scheme             = "EXTERNAL_MANAGED"
  certificate_manager_certificates = "//certificatemanager.googleapis.com/${local.map_id}"

  frontend_config = {
    name     = "apps-${terraform.workspace}"
    port     = 443
    protocol = "TCP"
  }

  backends                  = concat(local.apps_backends, local.servicedesk_backends)
  create_dns_record         = false
  cloud_armor_policy        = data.terraform_remote_state.waf.outputs.waf_policy_name
  cloudflare_zone_id        = local.hosted_zone_id
  health_check_port         = 80
  health_check_request_path = "/"
  app_public_name           = "apps-${terraform.workspace}"
}

resource "google_certificate_manager_certificate_map_entry" "map-entry" {
  for_each     = local.apps[terraform.workspace]
  name         = "map-entry-${each.value.name}"
  description  = "Map entry for ${each.value.name}"
  map          = local.map_name
  certificates = [local.certificate_manager_certificates]
  hostname     = each.value.host_patterns[0]
  labels       = local.default_labels
}

**Estado**: Infraestructura desplegada (LB backend, cert map, Cloudflare DNS, WAF attachado) pero **CERO tráfico** en logs. La app aún no tiene usuarios o no se ha aplicado el terraform en prod.

- **HTML en body** — `Ticket`, `Followup`, `KBArticle`, `TicketTask` aceptan contenido HTML — Rule 1040 (XSS) se va a disparar
- **File uploads** — Endpoint `Document` — Rule 1100 podría dispararse
- **Filtros complejos** — Parámetros de búsqueda tipo SQL — Rule 1030 potencial

### Cambio 1: Rule 1100 — Agregar id921120 a opt_out

### Cambio 2: Rule 1045 — Expandir a todos los Keycloak hosts
Actualmente solo cubre `keycloak.liftit.co`. QA usa `keycloak.qa.liftit-sandbox.com`.

### Cambio 3: Rule 1035 — Expandir a todos los API hosts
Actualmente solo cubre `api.liftit.co`. QA usa `api.qa.liftit-sandbox.com`.

### Cambio 5: Nueva regla 1036 — Excluir GLPI de PHP/XSS/SQLi
Preemptiva para `servicedesk.liftit.co` dado que:
- Todas las rutas contienen `api.php`
- Tickets aceptan HTML
- Filtros usan sintaxis tipo SQL

### Cambio 6: Rule 1110 — Excluir excel-loader de PHP check
El id933210 dispara en uploads de Excel (contenido binario matchea funciones PHP).

1000/min es muy bajo para agentes osquery (polling cada 10s por ~50 devices) y mobile app tracking. Propuesta: 3000/min, ban a 5000/min.

# sec/waf — Web Application Firewall (Cloud Armor)

## What This Module Does
Configures Google Cloud Armor WAF policies using direct `google_compute_security_policy` resources. One policy per workspace run — the workspace determines which GCP project the policy deploys to via `local.project_id[terraform.workspace]`. No provider aliases.

## Architecture
Single code path, workspace resolves the target project. Deploy per workspace: qa, staging, prod, sha, bi (sec workspace also supported).

- **Policy name pattern**: `waf-policy-${terraform.workspace}` (e.g. `waf-policy-qa`)
- **Rules**: 17 rules via `for_each = local.waf_rules` in waf.tf + 1 conditional IP whitelist (count-based)
- **Rule source**: `local.waf_rules` in `locals.tf` — single source of truth for all 17 rules (1010-1170)
- **IP whitelist**: `local.ip_whitelist` in `locals.tf` — workspaces without an entry skip rule 1000

## State
- **Backend**: GCS bucket `liftit-tf-state`, prefix `sec/waf`
- **Workspaces**: qa, staging, prod, sha, bi (+ sec)

## WAF Rules
| Priority | Action | Description | Status |
|----------|--------|-------------|--------|
| 1000 | allow | Trusted IPs whitelist (workspace-conditional, count-based) | active |
| 1010 | deny(403) | Malicious user-agents (15 bots) | preview |
| 1020 | allow | Stackdriver monitoring uptime checks (WAF-01 fix) | active |
| 1030 | deny(403) | SQL injection — evaluatePreconfiguredWaf sensitivity 1 | preview |
| 1040 | deny(403) | XSS — evaluatePreconfiguredWaf sensitivity 1 | preview |
| 1050 | deny(403) | Local file inclusion — evaluatePreconfiguredWaf sensitivity 1 | preview |
| 1060 | deny(403) | Remote code execution — evaluatePreconfiguredWaf sensitivity 1 | preview |
| 1070 | deny(403) | Remote file inclusion — evaluatePreconfiguredWaf sensitivity 1 | preview |
| 1080 | deny(403) | Method enforcement — evaluatePreconfiguredWaf sensitivity 1 | preview |
| 1090 | deny(403) | Scanner detection — evaluatePreconfiguredWaf sensitivity 1 | preview |
| 1100 | deny(403) | Protocol attacks — evaluatePreconfiguredWaf sensitivity 1 | preview |
| 1110 | deny(403) | PHP attacks — evaluatePreconfiguredWaf sensitivity 1 | preview |
| 1120 | deny(403) | Session fixation — evaluatePreconfiguredWaf sensitivity 1 | preview |
| 1130 | deny(403) | Java attacks — evaluatePreconfiguredWaf sensitivity 1 | preview |
| 1140 | deny(403) | NodeJS attacks — evaluatePreconfiguredWaf sensitivity 1 | preview |
| 1150 | deny(403) | CVE vulnerabilities — evaluatePreconfiguredWaf sensitivity 1 | preview |
| 1160 | deny(403) | SQLi in JSON — evaluatePreconfiguredWaf sensitivity 0, opt_in_rule_ids | preview |
| 1170 | rate_based_ban | Rate limit: 1000/min, ban at 2000/min for 5min | preview |

Note: Rules 1030-1150 use `evaluatePreconfiguredWaf` with sensitivity 1 (highest-confidence signatures only, lowest false positive risk). Rule 1160 uses sensitivity 0 with explicit `opt_in_rule_ids` to target one specific signature.

## Outputs
- `waf_policy_name` — scalar string, the policy name for this workspace. Remote state consumers reference it as:

```hcl
data "terraform_remote_state" "waf" {
  backend   = "gcs"
  workspace = terraform.workspace
  config = {
    bucket = "liftit-tf-state"
    prefix = "sec/waf"
  }
}
# data.terraform_remote_state.waf.outputs.waf_policy_name
```

## Dependencies (remote state)
| Name | Prefix | Workspace | Provides |
|------|--------|-----------|----------|
| folders | `project` | gen | gcp_folder_id, gcp_projects_ids |

## Providers
- Terraform `~> 1.14`, Google `~> 7.0`

## Notes
Most rules are in **preview mode**. WAF attachment and activation are Phase 3 work. Do NOT apply preview=false until per-LB exclusion rules are configured (see Phase 3 plan).
